::: {#def-mh}
#### Metropolis--Hastings algorithm

Given a target posterior $\p(\vparam \mid \vy)$,
a [proposal distribution](#def-proposal-distribution) $q(\cdot \mid \vparam)$,
and a starting value $\vparam^{(1)}$,
the **Metropolis--Hastings algorithm** produces $\vparam^{(t+1)}$ from $\vparam^{(t)}$ as follows
[@dobson4e, Chapter 13, p. 291]:

1. Draw a candidate $\vparam^* \sim q(\cdot \mid \vparam^{(t)})$.
2. Compute the [acceptance ratio](#def-acceptance-ratio) $\accept$.
3. With probability $\min(1, \accept)$, set $\vparam^{(t+1)} = \vparam^*$ (accept the candidate);
   otherwise set $\vparam^{(t+1)} = \vparam^{(t)}$ (reject it).
:::
